annotations.text:
One page per moment of your day.

Ready: do I need to fix something before open. One verdict on top, reasons below, a button per fix.

Market: world news filtered to what moves our stocks, the mood, and what is running that we are not in, with the reason we skipped it.

Book: what we hold, how far each is from its stop, and whether every engine is alive and picking. Trend-at-entry is shown on every row.

Review: every trade on candles with entry and exit arrows, losses grouped by cause, learnings recorded, and whether the ML has used them.

Nav is four tabs. Old pages live under Legacy.

Numbers are shaped like the real files: the ADANIPORTS trade, engine names, 10 Sep results, and the scorer's reasons are lifted from docs/paper-trades. The rest are sample values.

Three fields do not exist in the data yet and would be new engine work: trend-at-entry, loss cause, and candle-at-entry.
